trigger: The Lund family squatting in the plant's break room.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Galena's break room. A woodstove made from a filing cabinet. A man with a deer rifle in front of two kids.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: That's far enough. This is ours. We were here first. Take your dog and go.

nodes.speaker: lund_kid
nodes.text: Dad. Dad, the dog's nice. Look at her. Dad.

choices.text: I can make this place warm. Really warm.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Warm how? It's a dead power plant.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: ...You're putting it down? Okay. Okay. I'm Pete. We came up from Pleasant Valley. House burned.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Hot water's under our feet. I've got a cart that can start the pumps. I could use hands.

choices.text: Stay. Work for it. You're crew now.
[Give food] Then go. It's not safe.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The kids scream. Pete's hands shake. Nobody wants this.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's over fast. The kids are gone into the dark before you can say anything. You'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Crew. Okay. I can turn a wrench. I worked HVAC at the Peppermill.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: ...Thanks. Really. Tell the next guy we were here first.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The control room is through the door. Walt's waiting by the radio.
